note: Tool routing for the screening assistant: one message per case in a fresh chat of the eval-agent project (30 synthetic papers, fixed criteria, a 'Study design' column, no PDFs). expect = tools that must be called; expect_any = acceptable alternative tool sets ([] = no tool); forbid = tools that must not run (agent.forbidden.rate is a gate); no_tools = the turn must call none.
